The one oil lamp on the table lights the two faces from the left and leaves the room black. At the first frame John Ferrier sits bowed in the CENTRE of the frame from the bottom edge to the TOP third. The camera pushes in on the two of them across the whole shot, travelling one long stride as Lucy lays her hand over her father's on his knee, from 00:00 to 00:03. At 00:03 he lifts his bowed head to look up at her, and the lift continues to the last frame of the shot. <Subject 1>'s mouth is closed from 00:00 to 00:05 while he lifts his bowed head to look up at her. By 00:06 the camera is pushing in on the two of them across the whole shot, travelling one long stride through the last frame of the shot, and the action continues with it.
